figurative_meaning_en: Onomatopoeic word indicating the quick, rustling movement of reptiles or similar swift motions
example_sentences_in_bangla: কি যেন একটা সড়সড় করে চলে গেল।
ছেলেটা সড়সড় করে গাছে উঠে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: Something went slithering away with a sarsar sound.
The boy climbed the tree with a quick sarsar rustle.
note: This is primarily an onomatopoeic expression used to mimic swift, slithering movements in Bengali folklore and everyday speech.
